summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on April 21, 2026, announcing that it had released its Notice of AGM, Proxy Form, and Online Guide to the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX). The filing is an administrative submission under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for foreign private issuers. The attached Exhibit 99.1 corresponds to the routine annual general meeting materials. There is no special-situation transaction—no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital event. Instead, this is a standard current report disseminating meeting documentation.
